name: ad-recon
title_zh: 不碰密码不越权，把AD域摸成一张可下手的图
tagline_zh: 有凭据或零凭据都能侦察：用户/组/计算机、ACL委派、ADCS、现代LAPS、BloodHound。
tagline_en: Recon AD with or without creds: users, ACLs, ADCS, LAPS, BloodHound, dMSA/Ghost SPN, trusts. Maps only—no.
desc_en: Active Directory reconnaissance with or without credentials: user/group/computer enumeration, ACL/delegation, ADCS, modern Windows LAPS, BloodHound, Server 2025/dMSA/Ghost SPN candidates, and trust mapping. Recon only — do not exploit Kerberoast-to-DA, DCSync, or change passwords. Operator may select /ad-attack after cards are ready.
why_zh: 它把侦察与攻击硬性分离：卡片备好后由你手动选 /ad-attack，机制上杜绝了'顺手提权'的冲动。
why_en: Hard separation between recon and attack—you explicitly opt into /ad-attack after cards are ready. Covers bleeding-edge Server.
limit_zh: 只做侦察不做利用：不执行Kerberoast提权、DCSync或改密。需目标域可达且具备基本网络权限。
limit_en: Recon only—no Kerberoast-to-DA, DCSync, or password changes. Requires network reachability to target domain; zero-creds limited to unpatched public.
title_en: Map AD without exploits: users, ACLs, LAPS, BloodHound-ready
